body.label: Trigger
body.html: You or an adjacent ally is targeted by an Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Create a brief stone barrier; the target gains +2 Defense against the triggering Action. Remove the barrier after the Action resolves.

surges.html: Create a small aetheric or elemental object adjacent to an affected creature; it grants cover until the start of your next turn.
Increase the Defense bonus from this Reaction by 1.
